biography.value:
Description

A giant eyeball twice the size of a hume's torso approaches, walking on a mass of tentacles, other tentacles reaching out towards its prey. Sometimes also known as a “Cold Eye.”

Defense

AC 29, touch 14, flat-footed 24 (-1 size, +1 dodge, +4 Dex, +15 natural)

hp 120 [176] (16d8+48)

Fort +9, Ref +8, Will +10

Defensive Abilities Auto-Reflect

Immune death effects, confused

SR 24

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee 4 tentacles +16 (1d6+2)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 20 ft.

Special Attacks Doom Gaze, Flash, Self-Destruct, Thunder Beam

Statistics

Str 15, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 17, Wis 15, Cha 15

Base Atk +12; CMB +15; CMD 30 (34 vs. trip)

Feats Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (Tentacle), Weapon Finesse

Skills Climb +17, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (Arcana) +18, Perception +25, Sense Motive +18, Survival +17, Stealth +15; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

Ecology

Environment dungeons

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure standard

description.value: Beholders constantly benefit from a version of the Reflect status. Any spell which directly targets a beholder and fails to penetrate its spell resistance is turned back upon the original caster.

Every 1d4+1 rounds, a beholder may focus its gaze upon a single target within 30 feet as a standard action, causing them to perish. The target must make a DC 19 Fortitude save or drop to -1 hit points and begin dying. This is a death effect.

save.description: Negates dropping to -1 HP and dying

description.value: While below 50% hp, a beholder's central eye swells up massively, and it can explode at any time as a full-round action, destroying itself and dealing 12d6 points of fire and physical (half and half) damage to everything within a 15-ft. radius (Reflex save DC 19 for half damage). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Dungeoneering DC 17).
